purpose_context: This mission introduces a cross-cutting doctrine layer so Spec Kitty consistently catches install-time and dependency supply-chain risks before implementation and review approvals. It formalizes registry authenticity checks, package freshness visibility, lifecycle-script approval discipline, and Node LTS awareness across software-dev action flow and key agent profiles, with Shai-Hulud-class threats as the motivating scenario.
purpose_tldr: Add a built-in security checks layer for dependency and install-time supply-chain risks across software-dev workflows.
